name: Kong Konnect
description: Monitor Kong API gateway for team access and role-based API management compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to Kong Konnect at https://cloud.konghq.com (or eu.cloud / au.cloud for those regions)
2. Click your profile > Personal Access Tokens
3. Click "Generate Token", name it (e.g. "Comp AI"), and copy the token (starts with kpat_)
4. Paste the token below and select the region matching your Konnect tenant

The token inherits the permissions of the user that generated it; an Organization Admin or read-only auditor role is sufficient.
